name: Michael
role: TFAH literary character (Milton's Paradise Lost) -- field commander of Heaven's loyal army in the War in Heaven; later expels Adam and Eve from Eden.
description: TFAH literary character. Category A: named archangel across both testaments (Daniel 10:13,21, 12:1; Jude 1:9; Revelation 12:7). Milton's assignment of him to command the loyal army (Books V-VI) and expel Adam and Eve while narrating future biblical history (Books XI-XII) is narrative elaboration on a genuinely biblical warrior-archangel. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §V.
narrative_function: Wounds Satan in single combat during the War in Heaven; later shows Adam the future history of mankind (Books XI-XII).
